WODL45 DWHA 241500

STRONG WIND, GALE AND STORM WARNINGS FOR SEA AREAS:
GERMAN BIGHT, WESTERN AND SOUTHERN BALTIC.

GERMAN BIGHT:
W to SW 7 imminent, shifting S and increasing 8 to 9 soon, shifting 
SW to W later.  

WESTERN BALTIC:
S 7 to 8 later. 

SOUTHERN BALTIC:
S 7 to 8 later.

STARKWIND-, STURM- UND ORKANWARNUNGEN FUER DEUTSCHE KUESTEN.
